name: Patient and attendant
sub: The attendant (family member) does most of the work during a stay. Mobile web portal, WhatsApp and SMS; OTP login linked to the patient.
steps: Gets admission advice and a written estimate
Signs estimate and consents (e-sign or paper)
Gives insurance card or scheme ID
Gets IP number, bed, ward and visiting rules by SMS
Sees running bill and deposit balance daily on phone
Is told the expected discharge date a day ahead
Tracks discharge status: summary, bill, insurer approval
Gets summary, bill and Rx on WhatsApp; follow-up booked
can: See bed, doctor, running bill and deposit
Download estimate, receipts, summary and reports
cannot: See clinical notes or nursing charts
Leave without bill clearance or approved dues
Get more attendant passes than allowed
notify: Admission confirmed with bed and ward

name: Admission desk
sub: Turns an admission advice into an admitted patient with a bed, an IP number and a signed estimate.
steps: Sees admission request from doctor or emergency
Prepares estimate from tariff or package
Requests bed by category and gender
Hands insurance cases to the TPA desk
can: Cancel an admission before the patient is received
cannot: Admit without a doctor's admission order

name: Insurance (TPA) desk
sub: Gets cashless approvals on time and turns them into paid claims. Works with insurers, TPAs and government schemes.
steps: Verifies policy, ID and room-rent limit
Records approved amount on the bill
Watches bill vs approval every day
Sends final bill for discharge approval
can: Create and send pre-auth and enhancement
Split bill between insurer and patient
Flag non-payable items to patient share

name: Ward in-charge and bed manager
sub: Keeps beds flowing: allocates beds, runs transfers, pushes discharges and checks that cleaning is fast.
steps: Starts the day with census and expected discharges
Sees bed requests from admission and doctors
Allocates by category, gender and isolation
Approves transfers and ICU step-up or step-down
Sees vacated beds and cleaning tasks
Reviews falls, pressure injuries and incidents
can: Block beds for maintenance or isolation
cannot: Move a patient to a higher bed category without consent
Release a bed before cleaning is done
notify: Discharge planned but not started by noon

name: Staff nurse
sub: Delivers care every shift and records it once: medicines, vitals, charts and handover.
steps: Nursing assessment in 2 h: allergies, falls, pressure
Records vitals; early warning score flags
can: Record vitals, MAR, notes and charts
Raise ward indents and diet changes
cannot: Give a high-alert drug without a second nurse

name: Doctor (consultant and RMO)
sub: Admits, treats and discharges. The consultant owns the plan; the resident medical officer (RMO) covers rounds and nights.
steps: Advises admission with reason and expected stay
Initial assessment and plan within 24 h
Orders medicines, tests, diet and procedures
Orders transfer or ICU when needed
Sets expected discharge date a day ahead
Completes death or LAMA papers when needed
cannot: See patients outside own or shared care, without break-glass reason
Close a stay without a signed summary
kpis: Summary signed before 11:00 on discharge day

name: Pharmacy, lab and diet
sub: Fulfil in-patient orders patient-wise and charge them to the running bill automatically.
steps: Lab collects samples from ward round
Charges post to the bill automatically
Ward returns credited before final bill
can: Verify, substitute (with doctor approval) and issue
Accept returns and credit the bill
cannot: Issue without a valid order (except emergency with later order)
notify: Diet change or nil by mouth

name: In-patient billing
sub: Keeps the running bill right every day so the final bill is ready within minutes of discharge advice.
steps: Tracks deposit balance; sends top-up alerts
Prepares final bill on discharge advice
can: Add and cancel charges with reason
cannot: Give discounts above the limit without approval
Delete posted charges (only reverse with reason)
Clear a bill with pending pharmacy returns

name: Housekeeping and facility
sub: Turns a vacated bed into a clean, ready bed fast, and fixes what breaks.
steps: Gets cleaning task when a patient leaves
Marks bed ready; bed board turns Available
can: Mark a bed ready or blocked

name: IPD admin
sub: Sets up wards, beds, tariffs, packages, deposits, insurers and rules. Changes to money settings need approval.
steps: Creates wards, rooms, beds and categories
Adds insurers, TPAs and rate cards
can: Manage insurer panel and rate cards
cannot: Apply tariff changes without Super Admin approval
Delete a bed that has history (only retire)

name: Management
sub: Watches occupancy, length of stay, discharge speed, revenue per bed and quality, and approves exceptions.
steps: Morning census and occupancy by ward
Revenue per occupied bed and outstanding
can: See all IPD data across branches
